segments.text: How can I achieve something like the product I was trying to build that is called StoryRun?
The goal is just to be able to talk at any point of time and just feed a list of tasks that will be generated and orchestrated by some agents.
I want a product for this, either already made, a SaaS or something on GitHub, I don't care.
